rv.q: Amusing, angsty mother-son drama from Jonny Donahoe
All this adds to the overall awkwardness of the pair’s encounter in a beautifully realised miniature that is possessed with the gravity of something far larger.

cn.t: Critics praise Donahoe's two-hander about a fraught mother-son relationship, with Blythe Duff's performance as a violence-scarred mother earning particular acclaim in this emotionally resonant Play, Pie and Pint production.
